headline: Names a Marietta, Georgia post office after Marine Lance Corporal Squire 'Skip' Wells.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 2886 Sandy Plains Road in Marietta, Georgia. The building will now be called the "Marine Lance Corporal Squire 'Skip' Wells Post Office Building." It is a naming change only and does not alter postal services or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2016.
